mapper.sql:
FROM BOARD b JOIN TAG t ON b.TYPE_NO = t.TYPE_NO LEFT JOIN USER u ON b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' AND b.OPEN = 'Y'
AND b.IS_API_DATA = 'Y'
AND b.IS_API_DATA = 'N'
AND ( b.BOARD_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.INTRODUCE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(u.NICKNAME, b.NICKNAME) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INGREDIENT_SET iset JOIN INGREDIENT ing ON iset.SET_NO = ing.SET_NO WHERE iset.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO AND ing.INGREDIENT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
AND t.TYPE_NAME = #{category}
AND CASE WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('10분 이하', '10분 이내') THEN 10 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('10~20분', '20분 이내') THEN 20 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('20~30분', '30분 이내') THEN 30 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('30~45분', '45분 이내') THEN 45 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('45~60분', '1시간 이내', '60분 이내') THEN 60 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('1시간 이상', '60분 이상') THEN 9999 ELSE 9999 END <= CASE WHEN #{cookTime} IN ('15분 이내', '15분 이하') THEN 15 WHEN #{cookTime} IN ('30분 이내', '30분 이하') THEN 30 WHEN #{cookTime} IN ('1시간 이내', '60분 이내', '1시간 이하') THEN 60 ELSE 9999 END
AND t.DIFFICULT = #{difficult}
mapper.select:
SELECT b.BOARD_NO, b.USER_NO, b.BOARD_TITLE, b.INTRODUCE, b.IMAGE_URL, b.LIKES_COUNT, COALESCE(u.NICKNAME, b.NICKNAME) AS NICKNAME, b.IS_API_DATA, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_POSTDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BOARD_POSTDATE, t.TYPE_NAME, t.DIFFICULT, t.COOK_TIME, t.CALORY, t.AI
ORDER BY b.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC
ORDER BY b.LIKES_COUNT DESC, b.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('10분 이하', '10분 이내') THEN 10 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('10~20분', '20분 이내') THEN 20 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('20~30분', '30분 이내') THEN 30 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('30~45분', '45분 이내') THEN 45 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('45~60분', '1시간 이내', '60분 이내') THEN 60 WHEN t.COOK_TIME IN ('1시간 이상', '60분 이상') THEN 9999 ELSE 9999 END ASC, b.LIKES_COUNT DESC
ORDER BY b.LIKES_COUNT DESC, b.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE IS_API_DATA = 'Y'
SELECT NICKNAME FROM USER WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( USER_NO, TYPE_NO, BOARD_TITLE, NICKNAME, INTRODUCE, IMAGE_URL, URL, OPEN, IS_API_DATA, LIKES_COUNT, BOARD_DELETE, BOARD_POSTDATE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{typeNo}, #{boardTitle}, #{nickname}, #{introduce}, #{imageUrl}, #{url}, #{open}, #{isApiData}, 0, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.BOARD_NO, b.USER_NO, b.TYPE_NO, b.BOARD_TITLE, COALESCE(u.NICKNAME, b.NICKNAME) AS NICKNAME, b.INTRODUCE, b.IMAGE_URL, b.URL, b.OPEN, b.IS_API_DATA, b.LIKES_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(b.BOARD_POSTDATE, '%Y년 %c월 %e일') AS BOARD_POSTDATE, t.TYPE_NAME, t.DIFFICULT, t.COOK_TIME, t.CALORY, t.AI FROM BOARD b JOIN TAG t ON b.TYPE_NO = t.TYPE_NO LEFT JOIN USER u ON b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BOARD_DELETE = 'Y' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TAG (TYPE_NAME, DIFFICULT, COOK_TIME, CALORY, AI) VALUES (#{typeName}, #{difficult}, #{cookTime}, #{calory}, #{ai})
INSERT INTO INGREDIENT_SET (BOARD_NO, SET_NAME) VALUES (#{boardNo}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{setName}, ''), '재료'))
mapper.select: SELECT SET_NO, SET_NAME FROM INGREDIENT_SET WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INGREDIENT (SET_NO, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT) VALUES (#{setNo}, #{ingredientName}, #{quantity}, #{unit})

INSERT INTO INGREDIENT (SET_NO, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT) VALUES
(#{ing.setNo}, #{ing.ingredientName}, #{ing.quantity}, #{ing.unit})
mapper.select: SELECT INGREDIENT_NO, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT FROM INGREDIENT WHERE SET_NO = #{setNo}
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM INGREDIENT WHERE INGREDIENT_NO IN
#{no}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO COOK_STEP (BOARD_NO, COOK_CONTENT, COOK_IMAGE, STEP) VALUES
(#{step.boardNo}, #{step.cookContent}, #{step.cookImage}, #{step.step})
mapper.select: SELECT STEP, COOK_CONTENT, COOK_IMAGE FROM COOK_STEP WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} ORDER BY STEP ASC
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM COOK_STEP WHERE (BOARD_NO, STEP) IN
(#{step.boardNo}, #{step.step})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIKES WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT USER_NO FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
SELECT IS_API_DATA FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}

mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET LIKES_COUNT = LIKES_COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
UPDATE BOARD SET LIKES_COUNT = LIKES_COUNT - 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCRAP (BOARD_NO, USER_NO, SCRAP_DATE) VALUES (#{boardNo}, #{userNo}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SCRAP WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCRAP WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENT ( BOARD_NO, PARENT_COMMENT_NO, USER_NO, COMMENT_CONTENT, COMMENT_DELETE, COMMENT_POSTDATE ) VALUES ( #{boardNo}, #{parentCommentNo}, #{userNo}, #{commentContent}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.COMMENT_NO, c.PARENT_COMMENT_NO, c.USER_NO, c.COMMENT_CONTENT, c.COMMENT_DELETE, c.COMMENT_POSTDATE, u.NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM COMMENT c JOIN USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE c.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND c.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N' AND c.PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE ASC

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO, c.PARENT_COMMENT_NO, c.USER_NO, c.COMMENT_CONTENT, c.COMMENT_DELETE, c.COMMENT_POSTDATE, u.NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM COMMENT c JOIN USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE c.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo} AND c.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N' ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMENT SET COMMENT_DELETE = 'Y' WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO FROM COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo} AND COMMENT_DELETE = 'N'
SELECT BOARD_NO FROM COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo} AND COMMENT_DELETE = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT ( USER_NO, REPORTEE_NO, COMMENT_NO, BOARD_NO, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_REASON, REPORT_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{reporteeNo}, #{commentNo}, #{boardNo}, NOW(), #{reportReason}, #{reportType} )
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO, INTRODUCE FROM BOARD WHERE IS_API_DATA = 'Y' AND INTRODUCE != ''
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET INTRODUCE = '' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
